props.heading: Everything we hold, and why.
props.intro: We collect four things. Each has a reason, a lifespan and a switch. We have never sold data, and the company is structured so that we cannot.

In detail

Who we are

OroSkin Maison SAS, 9 Rue de la Fontette, Grasse, is the data controller for everything described here. Our data steward can be reached directly at privacy@oroskin.com — the address goes to a person, not a queue.

How we collect

Only what you type into a form, what your order needs, and — if you allow it — anonymous counts of how pages are used. We do not buy lists and we do not follow you across other sites.

Who else sees it

The courier sees your name and address; the payment provider sees your payment. Nobody else. Each is bound by a contract that forbids any use beyond the task.

Where it lives

On servers inside the European Economic Area. If a provider ever needs to move data outside it, we tell you first and use the standard contractual clauses.

How it is protected

Data is encrypted in transit and at rest, access is limited to the people who need it, and every access is logged. We test our defences twice a year.

Cookies and tracking

Essential cookies keep the basket working. Everything else waits for your consent, which you can change at any time on the cookie preferences page.

Children

Our shop is not made for people under sixteen and we do not knowingly collect their data. If you think we have, write to us and we will remove it.

Changes to this policy

If we change what we collect or why, we announce it in the monthly letter before it takes effect, and the version number above goes up.

Your rights

See it

A full copy of everything we hold, within 30 days.

Correct it

Fix anything wrong, straight from your account.

Delete it

Erased, not archived — bar what tax law forces us to keep.

Move it

Exported in a machine-readable file you own.

Object

Withdraw consent for analytics or personalisation at any moment.

Complain

To us first, or directly to the CNIL if we fail you.
props.ctaHeading: Exercise any of these in one message.
props.ctaText: Our data steward answers within one working day — no forms, no ticket numbers. Write to privacy@oroskin.com, or ask the concierge to pass it on.
